verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm https://docs.skyfire.xyz/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 without a key, and a re-recorded probe shows the same. It carries a structured Skyfire Developer Portal index. The docs pages are also served as raw markdown (.md URLs), which an agent can consume directly. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt content depth or coverage (e.g. an llms-full.txt), first-party docs describing the agent-oriented docs offering, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).
